glosses: each of the curved parts of the turquoise or other similar instruments

examples.en: She kissed him on the cheek.

examples.text: Tom tem uma cicatriz no queixo.
examples.en: Tom has a scar on his chin.

examples.text: Tom tentou manter o queixo erguido.
examples.en: Tom tried to keep his chin up.

examples.text: Ele pôs o guardanapo sob o queixo.
examples.en: He tucked the napkin under his chin.

examples.text: Tom colocou o braço dele sobre a Mary e beijou o queixo dela.
examples.en: Tom put his arm around Mary and kissed her cheek.
